storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Lotan has so many labels attached to her that no one knows how to approach this black-clad swordswoman.

Too humble and she will shatter your knees for being too boring; too arrogant and she will slash your insolence with her greatsword; too tough and she will soften your soul through battle.

But perhaps this is the arrogance befitting one born with the planet itself. As a former guardian, she has every right to her arrogance.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
In A.F. 180, as the Northern Hemisphere suffered a severe drought, the Korasuyu River ceased to flow.

Local residents unearthed a monstrous skeleton from the riverbed's silt. Since the Korasuyu River signifies "turbid water" in local culture, the skeleton was named the "Bone of Chaos."

Marine biologists identified it as the skeleton of a humpback whale, approximately 32 feet long and entirely covered in a silvery substance. The following year, this skeleton was auctioned at the Aethis auction house for 130 million Leonian Florins.

The auction house refused to disclose the true identity of the buyer, but rumors suggest that the skeleton was transported to a private university on the outskirts of Londinium.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
At Mythag University, the campus legend that "preparatory students must fight Lotan to become investigators" has spiraled out of control, driving fear of the black-clad swordswoman to an all-time high. Many students who specialize in theoretical research break into a cold sweat at the mere sight of a black hemline, dreading any chance of locking eyes with the "battle maniac" and meeting their end on the training ground.

In a brief exclusive interview conducted by Editor-in-Chief Hannah Peaslee, Miss Lotan offered the following remarks:
"I don't have time to play house with babies."

"Weaklings have no place being my opponent—are you one of them? Or do you have the nerve to face Chaos head-on?"

—As of press time, the editor-in-chief has not left her dormitory. This issue of the <Italic:Mythag Daily> was printed and distributed by intern editor Howard.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Lotan has her own criteria when it comes to choosing worthy opponents.

She finds academic warriors tiresome; most have read themselves into a stupor, their heads filled with nothing but theoretical maneuvers that fail on the field.

Military standouts, meanwhile, are too shackled by red tape and moral dogma to offer any real thrill.

Only those rare geniuses—blessed with raw talent and an innate instinct for slaughter—can earn her favor.

A primordial beast, as old as the planet itself, kept her thirst for battle in check and waited with near-religious patience for her chosen opponent to reach his zenith. What a gifted youth he was—commanding power from the abyssal deep, his formidable spirit capable of bridging even the Outer Gods. Given time, he would surely have grown into a warrior worthy of her blade.

But perhaps the vast stretches of time had dulled her judgment. This time, the Spirit of Chaos misjudged her mark. As for the details, Lotan refuses to speak of it to anyone.

All we know is that since then, she has held nothing but utter contempt for those who lack ambition or wallow in mediocrity.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Born from Chaos, she embodies pure chaotic power, an untamed free spirit, and an undefined order.

She craves challenges and battles; only by unleashing her irrepressible destructive urge can she fulfill her creator's sole wish.

—To safeguard this planet until the end. She has yearned for a truly exhilarating battle for far too long.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: New Keeper? Come on, give it your all. Let's see if you're worthy to face me!

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Now, my blade sings with power!

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Not bad.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: This feels like a rebirth.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Good. Less strain, more power.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Still a pale shadow of my true might.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Ah, back in the chaotic ocean. I like it.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: This beast is merely a fragment of my will. Its form may not change, but my power knows no bounds.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Shatter these barriers of power, just as I'd smash through a maze wall!

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Fine. You've put in enough effort. I suppose I'll tolerate you as a companion.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Hah! I've no time for childish games. Find a corner and stay out of my way.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Hmph... I still can't fathom why Ramona picked you as her partner. You reek of strength, yes, but you're nowhere near my league.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Yes, gaze upon me. I am this planet's most ancient being, demanding reverence from the insignificant. I've guarded this planet for eons. Is a thrilling battle truly too much to ask for in return?

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Interesting. Your growth in battle far surpasses my expectations. Given time, you might become... Strange. Even after all this time, I still find hope in a creature as seemingly weak as you.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Perhaps now is the time. Listen closely. Lotan, the Beast of the Stars, formally challenges you. Do not fret; I shall ensure your survival until you reach your zenith. I will not allow my chosen opponent to suffer the same fate again.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: What. Care for a fight?

daily.title: Chat: About Working
daily.content: My duties extend beyond fighting. Even in the Archean Eon, I had more to do than sit idly by... Hey, don't tell me you think I'm just some brute who only knows how to swing a sword?!

daily.title: Chat: About Tulu
daily.content: How dare you summon him! That useless, lazy oaf! He was once someone I held in high regard! Away with him! I refuse to look at that fool!

daily.title: Chat: About Extraterrestrial Beings
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring any one of Awakeners "Winkle," "Tinct," "Faint," or "Wanda".
daily.content: They feel alien. Not native to this planet, I bet.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: The Dissolution... I cannot speak freely of it. But know this: it appeared far earlier than you imagine.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Ramona is the only one here worth my time. She's quite gifted with a blade. The rest are so rigid and boring... Are you like them? Do you actually enjoy writing those tedious mission reports?

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I respect conviction, no matter if it's in a beast, an Awakener, or a human. If they can fight, even better.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Hate? I despise those who give up halfway. The mere thought of them makes me want to regurgitate last night's meal.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Why did I answer your call? To finish what I started, of course. And if you grow strong enough to challenge me, that's just a bonus.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: These weaklings aren't even worth my blade.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Hmph, not bad at all. Our next duel will be legendary.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Beast of the Abyss, consume them all!

traphase.title: Chat: About Vortice
